scope: Three synapse models and additive/multiplicative STDP in existing native network_core.lib; no production modifications
overall: No equation implementation defects found within tested scope; one GUI unit-label issue

findings.title: Conductance field shows physical units even for Izhikevich targets
findings.evidence: Izhikevich uses g*w*s*(Erev-V) as model current without HH Cm scaling; GUI unconditionally labels g as mS/cm². README already distinguishes model current units.
findings.reproduction: izh_conductance_units.json; raw/currents.csv includes both target models with Cm=2.5
findings.recommendation: Use model-current-unit/mV label for Izhikevich conductance, or explicitly document a physical conversion. No dynamics change is implied.

findings.title: ConductanceSTP uses reduced resource recovery, not three-pool conservation
findings.evidence: dx=(1-x)/tau_d and additive s can yield x+s>1; observed maximum 2.3362633545686364. TM instead uses dx=(1-x-y)/tau_d and passed resource-bound checks.

findings.title: Plasticity rescales the entire existing current tail
findings.evidence: At t=.002s a post-only event changes weight .6 to .7902458849001428; the existing tail efficacy changes by factor 1.3170764748335715. Documented and consistent with use of current w(t).

findings.title: Grouped events exclude mutual zero-lag pairs and multiplicative updates are clamped
findings.evidence: Old histories contribute to simultaneous groups; newly inserted events do not pair with each other. Bounds apply after the combined update. Explicit all-pairs oracle agrees in 2800 updates, including large traces and both limits.
findings.limitation: Sub-step event order is unavailable; halving dt is required to assess the effect in a network. At large A, multiplicative rule includes a hard safety boundary beyond its small-learning interpretation.

findings.title: RK4 synaptic flow converges against the exact fixed-event solution
findings.evidence: Fast-resource case errors in u/x/s decrease by 16.337 when dt halves from 50 to 25 us. Maximum errors: ConductanceSTP 1.58656048e-8 to 9.71137393e-10; TM 1.04364669e-8 to 6.38818581e-10.
findings.limitation: Fixed injected events isolate synaptic flow. This is not a fourth-order convergence assertion for threshold/reset dynamics of a free-running network.

excluded: Full neuronal trajectory and threshold accuracy
Astrocytic modulation of U and SIC
